Emily, saw Guidde raised $50M and is becoming the go-to for enterprises training thousands on tools like Workday and Salesforce.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Guidde off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Emily, quick follow-up for Guidde.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Guidde needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Guidde's reply rate likely compares to other recently funded SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Guidde either way.
